title: The Letter of Bellwether Lane
author: Emrys Ishikawa
blurb: Ines Iversen, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
